title: The Smudged Note
teaser: Professor Nibbles, the class hamster, has been kidnapped. The ransom: no spelling test on Friday.

booklet.briefing:
Room 4's hamster, Professor Nibbles, lives in a cage by the window. At morning break Ms. Lund checked on him, then went out to playground duty.

When she came back at 10:50, the cage door was open and Nibbles was gone. Tucked into the bars was a note written in blue gel pen, smudged all over:

“NIBBLES IS SAFE. CANCEL THE SPELLING TEST AND YOU WILL GET HIM BACK.”

Four pupils had permission to stay in Room 4 at break to finish their art projects. One of them wrote that note.
rules: Nibbles was taken between 10:30 and 10:50 am.
Only the four pupils below were allowed in Room 4 during break. The corridor monitor confirms no one else went in.

suspects.name: Ava Lindqvist
suspects.description: Top of the class at spelling. Feeds Nibbles on Mondays.
suspects.statement: I was painting my volcano the whole time. I'd never hurt Nibbles. I actually like spelling tests.

suspects.name: Ben Achterberg
suspects.description: Funny, restless and dreading Friday. Has a recorder lesson in the music room straight after break.
suspects.motive: Got 3 out of 20 in the last spelling test.
suspects.statement: I was gluing my collage. I didn't see anything. Maybe Nibbles escaped by himself?

suspects.name: Chloe Mensah
suspects.description: Sits nearest the cage. Wants to be a vet.
suspects.motive: Has said the cage is too small and Nibbles should be set free.
suspects.statement: I was cutting out my butterflies. I only looked up when Ben dropped the glue pot.

suspects.name: Dev Raman
suspects.description: Quiet, loves drawing. Felt poorly this morning.
suspects.statement: I felt sick so I went to the nurse almost straight away. I wasn't even in the room.

evidence.title: The ransom note
evidence.body:
Written in capitals with a blue gel pen from the class pen pot.

Every line is smeared. The smears run from left to right across letters that were already written.
lines: Written in capitals with a blue gel pen from the class pen pot.
Every line is smeared. The smears run from left to right across letters that were already written.

evidence.title: What the art teacher says about the smudges
evidence.body:
“Gel ink stays wet for a few seconds. A right-handed writer's hand moves ahead of the words, so it doesn't touch what they've just written.”

“A left-handed writer's hand slides over the words they've just written. That smears wet ink from left to right, exactly like this note.”

“This note was written by a left-handed person.”

evidence.title: Where Nibbles was found
evidence.body:
During Ben's recorder lesson, the music teacher heard scratching from the drum cupboard. Nibbles was inside a lunchbox with air holes, munching a carrot stick.

The lunchbox has a name sticker: B. ACHTERBERG.

questions.prompt: What do the smudges tell you about the note's writer?
questions.explanation: Smears running left to right across fresh words happen when the writing hand slides over what was just written, which is what a left-handed writer's hand does.

questions.explanation: The writer is left-handed, Dev was at the nurse's, and Nibbles turned up in Ben's lunchbox in the music room where Ben went straight after break.
hints: Two pupils write left-handed. Only one was in Room 4.
Where did Nibbles turn up, and who went there after break?
Check the name sticker on the lunchbox.

solution.explanation: Ben Achterberg popped Professor Nibbles into his own lunchbox, poked in a carrot stick and scribbled the ransom note left-handed in a hurry. His hand dragged across the wet gel ink and smudged every line. He hid Nibbles in the music room's drum cupboard, where he went straight after break. Nibbles is fine, and the spelling test is still on.

chain.step: The smudges show the note was written by a left-handed person.
Ben and Dev are the left-handers.
Dev was at the nurse's office for the whole break.
Nibbles was found in Ben's lunchbox in the music room.

eliminations.name: Ava Lindqvist
eliminations.why: Right-handed, so her writing wouldn't smudge like this.

eliminations.name: Chloe Mensah
eliminations.why: Right-handed. She does have a motive about the cage, which makes her a nice red herring.

eliminations.name: Dev Raman
eliminations.why: Lying down in the nurse's office from 10:31 to 10:52.
